caption: The drawing is divided into three main rectangular sections, two on the bottom and one large one at the top, all sharing a beige or light brown background filled with small dots. In the top section, there is a large, dark gray-blue figure with outstretched arms and legs, and a rounded head with a spiky crown-like shape on top. Near the upper left, there is a turtle-like form above the large figure. Below the turtle and to the left, there is a bird with wings spread out, drawn in red and white stripes, and near it is a smaller figure in black. Below them is a red, asterisk-like shape. In the bottom left section, there is a single figure in dark gray or blue, with elongated arms arching upwards and splayed fingers, thin legs, and a small circular head adorned with straight lines radiating outward. The bottom right section contains a row of pointed, triangular shapes in dark gray, arranged above a white base, and a small humanoid figure in red near the upper right corner of this section, shown in profile with one arm raised and the other bent near its mouth. All forms are rendered in a flat, simplified style using only red, dark gray-blue, and white, contrasting with the speckled beige background.
title: Petroglyph - Human Figures
